answer: Grab's deliveries GMV grew faster in FY2025 than in FY2024. Deliveries GMV increased 21% to $14.2 billion in 2025 from $11.7 billion in 2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.96], compared with growth of 13% to $11.7 billion in 2024 from $10.4 billion in 2023 [Grab, FY2024, p.140].
